Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODWindowState

CloseWindows

Document Shell

The CloseWindows method closes all windows belonging to the specified draft.

void CloseWindows (in ODDraft draft);
draft
A reference to the open draft object.
DISCUSSION
The document shell calls this method when closing a draft.

SEE ALSO
The ODWindowState::OpenWindows method (page 864).
